label: William of Ockham, Summa logicae I.14: A mental UNIVERSAL_1 can be numerically one while apt to…
locator: I.14: paragraphs beginning Est autem primo sciendum and Dicendum est igitur
interpretation: Bounded prose reading of the materialized Latin; no Lean declaration or mechanically verified inference is advertised. Reads the two senses of singular and the conclusion about universality by signification. Aptness for predication of many is not asserted actual plurality, infallibility or a modal-domain theorem.
